errors.text_span: динамиката на изменението на директната материална антропогенна активност (ДМА)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly expands the abbreviation ДМА as "директната материална антропогенна активност" (direct material anthropogenic activity). Based on the context of the paper title and the y-axis units (thousands of BGN), ДМА stands for "Дълготрайни материални активи" (Tangible Fixed Assets), a standard accounting term. The provided expansion is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: с плътна линия и кръгли маркери
errors.evidence: The description claims the lines have circular markers. In the figure, for each category, there is a solid line and a separate series of circular dots that are not connected to the line. The description misrepresents these two separate visual elements as a single line with markers on it. This error is repeated for all three data series descriptions.

errors.text_span: достига около 410 000 хил. лв. през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the orange line reaches about 410,000 in 2022. The line clearly ends higher, at approximately 420,000-425,000.

The phrase "след което се ускорява" (after which it accelerates) is an interpretation of the rate of change (the slope of the line), which is explicitly forbidden by the generation prompt's instruction to avoid interpretation.

The phrase "и се възстановява" (and recovers) is interpretive language that suggests a return to a previous or better state, rather than a neutral description of the data increasing. The prompt requires objective description without interpretation.

errors.text_span: като най-високата стойност през целия период се наблюдава при „Обработване и обезвреждане на отпадъци“.
errors.evidence: This final clause compares the three lines to identify which one has the highest value. The generation prompt explicitly forbids comparing the lines.
